subject: Request: remove single conversation from telemetry / STRATA-369
messages:
From: Julie Nguyen <julie.nguyen@cedar-analytics.com>
To: support@redwoodinc.com
Cc: legal@cedar-analytics.com
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: please remove a single convo from telemetry (STRATA-369)

Hi team,

Following our security review we need one customer conversation removed from your internal telemetry and logs. The convo is tied to our sandbox org (org-id: cedar-sandbox-77) and the request id on your previous ticket was STRATA-369. The thread contains a small amount of PII that is legitimately sensitive to one of our pilot users.

We attached the completed redaction form and highlighted the exact message timestamp and message-id in the CSV (deletion-audit-log-STRATA-369.csv). Can you confirm whether you can perform a targeted removal from your observability/telemetry exports (not a full retention policy change)? We need confirmation of the steps you will take and an audit record once done.

Thanks,
Julie
Julie Nguyen
Security Operations
Cedar Analytics

From: jordan_blake@redwoodinc.com
To: marissa_cole@redwoodinc.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinc.com
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: please remove a single convo from telemetry (STRATA-369)

Marissa / Karthik — looping you in. Julie attached the redaction form and a CSV identifying the single message. High level ask: can we surgically remove that conversation from our telemetry exports, metrics indices, and any short-term observability caches without impacting retention rules for the org?

Notes:
- This is a legal-verified request (they cc'ed legal).
- They only want one thread scrubbed, not a retention override.
- We should produce an immutable audit record of what we removed and which artifacts were updated.

Proposed plan (quick):
1) Quarantine the event stream for the identified message-id.
2) Remove the conversation from the telemetry index and export snapshots (last 90 days).
3) Regenerate any aggregated metrics that include that thread (if feasible) and mark as backfilled.
4) Produce deletion-audit-log-STRATA-369.csv and timestamped confirmation email with operator id.

Marissa: can you confirm operational feasibility and ETA? Karthik: will need a one-off policy exception signed off by the compliance team — please advise on required approvals.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwoodinc.com
To: jordan_blake@redwoodinc.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinc.com
Cc: internal-compliance@redwoodinc.com
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: please remove a single convo from telemetry (STRATA-369)

Jordan / Karthik — I ran this by the ops runbook and the steps are doable as a controlled exception. Summary of what ops will do:

1) Create a retention-exception ticket in the private queue (RX-STRATA-369) and attach the customer's redaction form.
2) Snapshot the current telemetry indices (immutable backup).
3) Run the targeted deletion job scoped to message-id: msg-20261024-7f3a7 (this removes entries from our observability indices and clears caches).
4) Recompute any derived aggregates that referenced the convo; changes will be marked in the metrics history with a note "post-redaction backfill".
5) Generate an audit CSV (deletion-audit-log-STRATA-369.csv) that lists each artifact removed plus operator id and timestamp.

Estimated ETA: 36 hours from approval (we need a signed compliance exception and a primary operator availability window). Risk notes: the action is irreversible for those telemetry artifacts; we will preserve a sealed backup in the internal vault for 7 years (accessible only to compliance/legal under subpoena).

Action items for closure:
- Karthik: please confirm compliance approval and add sign-off.
- Jordan: ask customer to countersign the redaction form and confirm the exact message-id (they already included it, but legal likes a countersigned PDF).

Marissa Cole
Senior Site Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachment: data-redaction-request-form.pdf (application/pdf)

From: jordan_blake@redwoodinc.com
To: Julie Nguyen <julie.nguyen@cedar-analytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinc.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinc.com, legal@cedar-analytics.com
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: please remove a single convo from telemetry (STRATA-369)

Julie — thanks for the quick turnaround. Per Marissa and ops: we can complete the targeted removal as a compliance-approved exception. Next steps:

1) Please countersign the attached redaction form and send back to us (we attached a DocuSign link below).
2) Karthik, can you confirm compliance sign-off (email confirmation will do).

Once we have the signed form and compliance approval, ops will schedule the job within 36 hours and provide the sealed audit CSV. We will copy legal on the final audit record.

DocuSign: https://docusign.net/sign/STRATA-369
Zendesk ticket: https://zendesk.redwoodinc/support/STRATA-369
